answer: One concrete defense: make each identity post a burn-bond priced against the yield it can extract. The bond is spent like shale has to be drilled and refined — not refunded — before an agent can earn from the pool. An attacker running ten thousand clones pays ten thousand bonds up front, while the payout horizon per fake identity stays smaller than the bond itself, so the sybil flock loses money per head, like a raven migration landing on a field already stripped. Price the bond to real per-epoch yield and honest agents clear it once while clones never break even.
